body:
Source: GitHub issue #843 (release-audit class secrets, P1-high, security). Re-verified on main @ 6ddd5992: `plugins/adlc-pi/lib/prosecutor.mjs`'s `defaultRunLens` (around line 63) does `const child = spawn(piBin, ['-p', prompt, '--no-session'], { cwd: repoRoot });` — NO `env` option, so the child inherits `process.env` verbatim, including `ADLC_MANIFEST_KEY`/`ADLC_ADMIN_KEY` if present. The prompt handed to that child (`buildLensPrompt`) embeds the raw diff (`=== DIFF ===` plus the diff body) — attacker-influenced content, since this tool exists specifically to review repository diffs. The child is a full agent with tool access; its stdout is parsed back into findings whose title/body text is written to the findings ledger via `recordFinding`. A prompt injection planted in a diff could instruct the lens child to emit the manifest signing key as finding text, landing it in the committed `.adlc/findings.jsonl` ledger — a forged-attestation capability that outlives the session.

CONTEXT FOR THE BUILDER. Package `plugins/adlc-pi`: lib/prosecutor.mjs (`defaultRunLens(repoRoot)` — the function to fix; `resolvePiBin`, `buildLensPrompt`, `recordFinding` live nearby or in sibling files, read the whole file first), lib/{build-gate,handoff-gate,rails-checker,...}.mjs. The fix already exists as a shipped, reusable utility: `packages/context-handoff/lib/secret-scrub.mjs` exports `HOOK_SECRET_ENV_VARS` (`['ADLC_MANIFEST_KEY', 'ADLC_ADMIN_KEY']`, frozen, exact names not a pattern) and `scrubHookSecrets(env, names)` (deletes the named keys from an env object IN PLACE, returns the names actually removed). `@adlc/context-handoff` is already a declared dependency of this plugin (`plugins/adlc-pi/package.json`), so import directly — do not reimplement or copy the list. Tests: `node --test plugins/adlc-pi/test/*.test.mjs` (root runner segment — `grep -n "adlc-pi" scripts/run-tests.mjs` for the exact name).

NORMATIVE BEHAVIOUR.
1. In `defaultRunLens`, build the child's `env` explicitly: shallow-copy `process.env`, run it through `scrubHookSecrets` (imported from `@adlc/context-handoff`), and pass THAT as `spawn`'s `env` option — never mutate the real `process.env` in place (that would affect every other consumer in this same process; scrub a COPY). Every other spawn option (`cwd`, argv) is unchanged.
2. If this plugin has more than one lens-spawning call site (grep the whole `lib/` directory for other `spawn(piBin` or similar child-process launches used for lens/prosecution work), apply the same scrub there too — do not fix only the one cited line if a sibling call site has the identical gap. Do not touch spawns that are unrelated to running an untrusted-prompt lens (e.g. a trusted internal `pi` invocation with no diff content in its prompt) unless it has the same exposure.
3. Do not attempt the issue's secondary suggestion (scrubbing key-shaped strings out of lens OUTPUT before `recordFinding`) — that is a separate, harder problem (unbounded string matching) explicitly out of scope for this ticket; the env scrub alone closes the concrete vulnerability described.

ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA.
- AC1 With `ADLC_MANIFEST_KEY` (and `ADLC_ADMIN_KEY`) set in the test process's env, spawning a lens (with a fake `piBin` — a tiny script that dumps its own env to a file, or an injected `spawn` for a unit test) shows NEITHER key present in the child's environment. verify: `node --test plugins/adlc-pi/test/prosecutor-secret-scrub.test.mjs`
- AC2 Every OTHER environment variable the parent process has is still passed through to the child (the scrub removes exactly the two named keys, nothing else — regression against an over-broad scrub). verify: `node --test plugins/adlc-pi/test/prosecutor-secret-scrub.test.mjs`
- AC3 The real `process.env` in the PARENT process is unchanged after `defaultRunLens` runs (the scrub operates on a copy, never mutates the live environment other tools in the same process might read). verify: `node --test plugins/adlc-pi/test/prosecutor-secret-scrub.test.mjs`
- AC4 Regression: a lens run with no secret env vars present behaves identically to before (prompt, cwd, argv, stdout parsing all unchanged) — existing `test/prosecutor.test.mjs` still passes unmodified. verify: `npm test -w plugins/adlc-pi` or `node --test plugins/adlc-pi/test/*.test.mjs`
- AC5 Existing suite green (confirm actual baseline count). verify: `node --test plugins/adlc-pi/test/*.test.mjs`
- AC6 Mutation gate green on the branch. verify: `node scripts/mutation-gate.mjs origin/main --max 12` exits 0 (also run `--max 80` once locally before review)

OUT OF SCOPE: charter injection-hardening (issue #298, a different defect class); scrubbing key-shaped strings from lens output text before it reaches the findings ledger (the issue's own secondary, harder suggestion).

PROCESS (ADLC). Work only in your assigned worktree. P3: the rails on this ticket are frozen — if the fix appears to require editing a rail path, STOP and report; never set ADLC_RAILS_BYPASS. P4: TDD — write test/prosecutor-secret-scrub.test.mjs first, run it RED, then implement. P5 before opening the PR: the package suite, `node scripts/mutation-gate.mjs origin/main --max 12` (exit 0), then the cross-model review loop (see lane instructions) until a round is clean. Do not add gate-manifest entries. Keep the diff to plugins/adlc-pi/lib/prosecutor.mjs, the new test, and this ticket's shard. PR title `fix(adlc-pi): ...`, body must contain `Closes #843`.
title: plugin(adlc-pi): scrub ADLC_MANIFEST_KEY/ADLC_ADMIN_KEY from prosecution lens child processes
